column1: [System Logging] Why is forwarding system logs to a centralized log management server considered a security best practice?
column2: It prevents attackers who compromise a local host from modifying or deleting local log files to hide their activity.

column1: [File Permissions] If a user's umask is set to 0027, what default permissions are assigned to a newly created file?
column2: rw-r----- (640 octal), meaning group has read-only access and others have no access.

column1: [Security Configuration] In Linux, which PAM configuration files typically enforce password complexity and minimum length requirements?
column2: Files within /etc/pam.d/ (such as common-password or system-auth).

column1: [Host Security] Why should a local host-based firewall (e.g., ufw, firewalld, or nftables) be enabled on a server even if an enterprise network firewall is present?
column2: It provides defense-in-depth, protecting the server against unauthorized internal network traffic, lateral movement, or compromised internal hosts.
